pricing.note: Argon Standard introductory rates through 2026-11-30; recheck before later runs.
Flash 3.8 Standard introductory rates through 2026-12-31; implicit cache only in this benchmark.
Standard, global processing; GPT-6.1 Sol writes at 1.25x input. Under 100K input only in this version.
Opus 5.5 Standard, global processing; 5-minute automatic cache writes.

warnings: Sequential requests; no automatic retries. Fresh nonce per trial isolates cache prefixes.
Cost guard is an estimate and an observed-spend soft stop, not a guaranteed billing cap. Output cost is reported separately from input-cache multipliers.
